name: Yamabe no Akahito
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 4); Porter’s note gives the dates as: lived c. 700.

poems.title: I started off along the shore
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 4
poems.text:
I started off along the shore,
The sea shore at Tago,
And saw the white and glist’ning peak
Of Fuji all aglow
Through falling flakes of snow.

poems.title: 4. 田子の浦に 打出でてみれば 白妙の (Tago no ura ni uchiidete mireba shirotae no)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
田子の浦に 打出でてみれば 白妙の
ふじの高嶺に 雪は降りつつ
